parameters.name: Configuration
parameters.description: The configuration information of the reserved instances. Array length: 1 to 100.

sub_parameters.name: InstanceAmount
sub_parameters.description: The number of pay-as-you-go instances of the same instance type that the reserved instance can match simultaneously. Valid values: ≥ 1.

sub_parameters.name: InstanceType
sub_parameters.description:
The instance type that the reserved instance can match.

> Applicable instance types are continuously updated. For more information, see [Reserved instance overview](~~100370#3c1b682051vt4~~).

sub_parameters.name: ReservedInstanceName
sub_parameters.description:
The name of the reserved instance.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or Chinese character and cannot start with http:// or https://. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), or hyphens (-).

sub_parameters.name: Scope
sub_parameters.description:
The scope of the reserved instance. Valid values: 

- Region: regional.
- Zone: zonal.

Default value: Region.

sub_parameters.name: ZoneId
sub_parameters.description:
The zone ID of the reserved instance.

This parameter is required when the `Scope` parameter is set to `Zone`.

You can call [DescribeZones](~~25609~~) to query the zone list.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the reserved instance.

You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ReservedInstanceId
parameters.description: The IDs of the reserved instances. Array length: 1 to 20.
